description: Append-only compact index of cumulative token-saving experiment records. Raw transcripts, usage logs, verifier output, quality reviews, and generated artifacts live under sources/evaluations/<study-id>/ or sources/evaluations/fixtures/large/<project-id>/runs/<evaluation-id>/.
append_policy: Add one immutable run record per executed baseline/treatment. Add paired_comparison records only after baseline and treatment run records exist. Supersede rather than edit historical results except for path typo correction with rationale.
